title: Israeli Settlers Turn a Palestinian Rite Into a Gantlet of Violence and Fear
summary_full: This year’s olive harvest in the Israeli-occupied West Bank is the most violent in years, as settlers have attacked farmers and besieged homes, drawing condemnation from U.S. officials and others.
